explanation:
The central tree preserves the ownership and persistence path while shrinking the seed from 90 to 57 lines (36.7%) and from 6,528 to 3,948 characters (39.5%). Five peripherals expand session boundaries, record projection, delivery failures, acknowledgement ordering, and lifetimes. [M] denotes modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership, and [D] data dependencies. Connections attach to the concepts they expand; positions leave gaps between measured text bounds.

Evidence comes only from the supplied point, seed, and seven pinned sources. Added details include copyDocument's reset of conversation pending state and request receipts (canvasWorkspace.ts and MappingPage.tsx), pause/resume catch-up and active-ID fallback (workspacePersistence.ts), worker reinitialization before full projection (workspaceStorage.worker.ts), and projection undo's child-only replacement (MappingPage.tsx).

The seed needs two qualifications: cached encoded retry bodies survive only within a worker's lifetime; after worker replacement, RecordStorage retains the batch but the new worker normalizes and encodes it again. Also, visited editors survive ordinary switching, but workspaceEpoch or reloadKey changes remount them. Automatic retry suppression does not prohibit an explicit flush from retrying a retained flight (recordStorage.ts).

Renderer ownership and pointer-sample behavior are stated contracts in canvasSession.ts; renderer internals are not supplied. Controller, record-codec, and server implementations are also absent, so their internal algorithms, server atomicity, and end-to-end idempotency are not independently established here.

[O/C/D] Record delivery: pending changes, flight and worker
|-- RecordStorage owns optimistic cache and submission sequences
|   |-- Recursive value equality skips unchanged records
|   |-- Latest pending change wins per key; accepted batch increments sequence
|   `-- New flight captures pending values, sequence, revision and UUID
|-- pump serializes writes through one running promise
|   |-- New submissions accumulate separately while flight is retained
|   |-- Success advances revision/persisted sequence and clears flight
|   `-- Failure keeps flight, records error and increments failure count
|-- Retry mechanisms differ
|   |-- Timer backoff: min(30000, 500 * 2^min(failures, 6)) ms
|   |-- Timer scheduling stops on REJECTED or either conflict marker
|   |-- Explicit flush can still call pump with a retained flight
|   `-- commit retries after 500 ms unless REJECTED or disposed
|-- Worker keeps bodies and known records in memory
|   |-- Normalize once; cache JSON body under batch request ID
|   |-- Parsed HTTP 4xx -> delete body; report REJECTED
|   |-- Other HTTP failures -> retain body; report uncertain write
|   `-- Success updates known records from submitted body; removes body
|-- Worker failure rejects pending message promises and terminates worker
|   |-- Next request lazily creates a replacement worker
|   |-- RecordStorage retains request ID, expectedRevision and changes
|   `-- Replacement has no body cache; normalizes/encodes again
`-- Full workspace projection needs a complete known key set
    |-- Fresh/restarted worker reads current server state before project
    |-- Changed/new values -> writes; missing known keys -> deletions
    `-- In-flight write retry can proceed before that initialization

[C/O] Acknowledgement controls explicit UI installation
|-- Transfer
|   |-- Pause adapter and block competing workspace operations
|   |-- Verify source revision; capture histories, display and camera
|   |-- Prepare source/destination states and transfer transaction
|   |-- storage.save -> flush -> worker project -> commit
|   `-- Then installWorkspace replaces sessions, view state and epoch
|-- Projection creation
|   |-- Check source version before and after asynchronous preparation
|   |-- saveDocument(child, index, true) rejects existing child metadata
|   `-- After commit add child; retain all existing sessions/editors
|-- Projection undo/redo
|   |-- Persist child and updated index before installing child state
|   `-- Replace child session/reload key; preserve unrelated sessions
|-- RecordStorage.commit
|   |-- Flush prior submissions before capturing cache for rollback
|   |-- Batch transaction, then flush until acknowledged
|   |-- REJECTED restores cache, clears pending/flight, marks sequence settled
|   `-- Other errors retry same flight; no automatic UI installation here
`-- Project publication has a separate saved-baseline boundary
    |-- Capture document/name/version; sync and flush editing history
    |-- Recheck version; publishMappingCheckpoint with captured revision
    `-- Receipt updates captured baseline; preserve a newer current name

[O] Session, editor and storage lifetimes
|-- Workspace registry owns sessions independently of editor mounting
|   |-- Active IDs enter mountedDocuments; only extant drafts render
|   |-- Switching hides/disables visited editors without dropping sessions
|   `-- Editor key = workspaceEpoch + document ID + reloadKey
|-- Renderer boundary stated in CanvasSession
|   |-- Mounted editor owns live geometry and undo navigation
|   |-- Pointer/camera samples do not publish session application state
|   `-- Page camera callback writes separate SourcePaneViewState
|-- Persistence effect requires loaded workspace, project and records
|   `-- Cleanup removes adapter, storage-status and visibility subscriptions
|-- View-state replacement/unmount -> flush and dispose old view state
|-- Page cleanup schedules disposal with setTimeout(..., 0)
|   |-- Effect setup cancels a pending disposal
|   |-- Dispose prompts and workspace; detach session subscriptions
